scenarios.title: A｜信用卡被拒
scenarios.setting: 玩家在商店付款时信用卡被拒。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but your card was declined.

turns.prompt: 你想请店员换一种方式再尝试刷卡，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s strange. Could you try it again?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s strange. Could you try it again?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could I try inserting the card instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I try inserting the card instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Do you know why it was declined?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know why it was declined?
feedback.explanation: “declined”支付语境中表示交易被拒，说明付款未成功。

choices.text: Let me try another card.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let me try another card.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Why did you refuse my card?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s strange. Could you try it again?
feedback.explanation: “you refuse”把交易被拒归因于收银员；先说卡被拒并询问能否重试，更符合实际操作。

turns.text: We can try it one more time.

turns.prompt: 关于「银行卡无法使用」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll use a different card.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll use a different card.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Can I pay in cash instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I pay in cash instead?
feedback.explanation: “cash”指现金，是说明付款方式的直接用词。

choices.text: I’ll contact my bank and see what’s going on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll contact my bank and see what’s going on.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.prompt: 关于「银行卡无法使用」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: My credit card was declined when I tried to make a purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: My credit card was declined when I tried to make a purchase.
feedback.explanation: “declined”支付语境中表示交易被拒，说明付款未成功。

choices.text: My card has been declined twice today. Could you check what’s wrong?

feedback.naturalExpression: My card has been declined twice today. Could you check what’s wrong?
feedback.explanation: “what’s wrong”询问出了什么问题，适合在不清楚原因时先了解情况。

choices.text: I tried to pay at a store, but the payment wouldn’t go through.

feedback.naturalExpression: I tried to pay at a store, but the payment wouldn’t go through.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

scenarios.title: B｜银行卡被冻结
scenarios.setting: 在“银行卡无法使用”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“银行卡被冻结”。

turns.text: I can see that there’s currently a restriction on your card.

turns.prompt: 你想向银行了解卡片被冻结的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Why has my card been blocked?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why has my card been blocked?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Was my card frozen because of suspicious activity?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was my card frozen because of suspicious activity?
feedback.explanation: 补充原因或目的，让对方明白提出这个想法的依据。

choices.text: Did the bank block it for security reasons?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did the bank block it for security reasons?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Can you tell me what caused the restriction?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you tell me what caused the restriction?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Why did you close my card?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Why has my card been blocked?
feedback.explanation: “close my card”像在说注销；暂时冻结应使用“freeze / block”，以免请求被误解。

turns.text: We noticed a transaction that was unusual for your account.

turns.prompt: 你想核查触发银行卡安全限制的交易，会怎么说？

choices.text: Which transaction was flagged?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which transaction was flagged?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: Could you tell me when and where the transaction was made?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me when and where the transaction was made?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: Was it the purchase I made earlier today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was it the purchase I made earlier today?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: There was a purchase this morning that triggered our security system.

turns.prompt: 你想核实这笔交易是否由自己操作，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, that was me. I made that purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that was me. I made that purchase.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I don’t recognize that transaction.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize that transaction.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: No, I definitely didn’t make that purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I definitely didn’t make that purchase.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: I’m not sure. Could you give me more details?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. Could you give me more details?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Okay. We’ll go through the verification process with you.

turns.prompt: 你想确认解除银行卡限制需要怎样配合核实，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. What do you need me to verify?

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. What do you need me to verify?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Okay. Will I be able to use my card again after that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Will I be able to use my card again after that?
feedback.explanation: “will I be able to”确认某个条件下自己是否还能完成后续安排。

scenarios.title: C｜联系银行确认原因
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现银行卡连续无法付款，于是联系银行客服。

turns.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help?

turns.prompt: 你想描述遇到的故障并寻求处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: My card isn’t working, and I’d like to find out why.

feedback.naturalExpression: My card isn’t working, and I’d like to find out why.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Several of my payments have been declined today.

feedback.naturalExpression: Several of my payments have been declined today.
feedback.explanation: “declined”支付语境中表示交易被拒，说明付款未成功。

choices.text: I haven’t been able to use my card since this morning. Could you check what’s wrong?

feedback.naturalExpression: I haven’t been able to use my card since this morning. Could you check what’s wrong?
feedback.explanation: “what’s wrong”询问出了什么问题，适合在不清楚原因时先了解情况。

choices.text: Could you check whether there’s a problem with my account?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether there’s a problem with my account?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: My bank card can’t use today.

feedback.naturalExpression: My card isn’t working, and I’d like to find out why.
feedback.explanation: 卡片不能主动“use”；说“My card isn’t working”表示无法使用，再说明付款时出现的提示。

turns.text: I’ll take a look. Were you trying to use the card online or in person?

turns.prompt: 你想向银行说明银行卡在哪种交易中无法使用，会怎么说？

choices.text: I was trying to pay in a store.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was trying to pay in a store.
feedback.explanation: “I was trying to”交代当时正在尝试的操作，适合解释故障发生在哪一步。

choices.text: It was an online purchase.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was an online purchase.
feedback.explanation: “online purchase”指网上购买或线上交易，用来区分付款发生的渠道。

choices.text: Both. It was declined online and at a store.

feedback.naturalExpression: Both. It was declined online and at a store.
feedback.explanation: “declined”支付语境中表示交易被拒，说明付款未成功。

choices.text: I also tried withdrawing cash, and that didn’t work either.

feedback.naturalExpression: I also tried withdrawing cash, and that didn’t work either.
feedback.explanation: “cash”指现金，是说明付款方式的直接用词。

turns.text: Have you recently traveled or made any unusual purchases?

turns.prompt: 关于「银行卡无法使用」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, I’m currently traveling abroad.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’m currently traveling abroad.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Yes. I made a fairly large purchase yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I made a fairly large purchase yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: No, nothing unusual that I can think of.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, nothing unusual that I can think of.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I made a few purchases in different cities this week. Could that be the reason?

feedback.naturalExpression: I made a few purchases in different cities this week. Could that be the reason?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

turns.text: It looks like the card was temporarily restricted for security reasons.

turns.prompt: 你想了解怎样解除银行卡的使用限制，会怎么说？

choices.text: What do I need to do to remove the restriction?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do I need to do to remove the restriction?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can you help me get the card working again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you help me get the card working again?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: How long will it take before I can use the card again?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will it take before I can use the card again?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to verify first?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to verify first?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: I’ll need to verify some information with you first.

turns.prompt: 你想配合银行核实身份和账户信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. What information do you need?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What information do you need?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Okay. I’m ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’m ready.
feedback.explanation: “I’m ready”说明自己已经准备好，可以进入下一步。
